title: Tool Room Technician
summary: Build and maintain the progressive dies, deep-draw tools and weld fixtures that every press on our floor depends on. This is the role closest to the heart of how we work.
responsibilities: Manufacture die and fixture components using VMC, surface grinding, milling, turning and drilling equipment
Assemble, try out and prove progressive and deep-draw dies
Diagnose and correct tooling problems reported from the press floor
Carry out planned die maintenance and keep tool history records current
Work with production to improve tool life and reduce setup time
requirements: ITI / Diploma in Tool & Die Making or Mechanical Engineering
Hands-on experience with progressive or deep-draw press tooling
Ability to read and work from engineering drawings and GD&T
Competence with surface grinders, milling machines and measuring instruments
VMC programming or operating experience is an advantage
